description: A rectangular, tufted ottoman with a plush, light-colored fabric seat. The seat is deeply button-tufted in a diamond pattern, creating a luxurious and inviting texture. It rests on a striking X-shaped base made of polished chrome or stainless steel. The metallic legs provide a modern contrast to the soft upholstery, offering a blend of comfort and contemporary style. This versatile piece can serve as a footrest, extra seating, or a decorative accent.
